-2-  MFA No. 6300 of 2017 PASSED IN MVC NO.1356/2010 ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE & JMFC, MACT-15, KUNIGAL, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT 1.

The claimant, being dissatisfied with the compensation of Rs.1,41,979/- awarded by the Tribunal,
is in appeal.
2. The fact that the accident occurred and the further fact that the offending vehicle was insured is not in dispute.

3. The Tribunal, on assessment of the evidence, has recorded a finding that the claimant has suffered the following injuries:
"Pain and tenderness over left chest and fracture of ribs No.2 to 8 on left side with flail chest and drain insertion."
4. The Tribunal has thereafter awarded the following sums as compensation:
 Sl. Compensation under Amount  No. different Heads in (Rs.)
 1. Pain and sufferings 30,000
2 . Loss of future income 51,840

3. Medical expenses 49,139  Conveyance, nutritious food,
 4. diet, attendant charges during 11,000  hospitalization  Total 1,41,979 5.
The doctor, who has examined as PW-3 has stated that the claimant had suffered disability of about 60% to the left lung and 30% to the whole body.

He has stated that the claimant had Prakash vs Jyothi Kumar on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20744665/
2 complaints of breathlessness, cough and he was unable to do routine work and it is also stated that air entry was reduced to the left hand side and so also the chest movement.
In my view, since it is stated that there was a disability about 60% to the left lung, it would be appropriate to determine the disability to the whole body at 15%.
6. The Tribunal has determined the monthly income, notionally at Rs.4,500/-.

Since there is no credible documentary evidence to ascertain the actual monthly income, it would be appropriate and prudent to adopt the monthly income determined by Karnataka State Legal Services Authority,
which, for the accident of the year, 2010 would be Rs.5,500/-.
7. As the claimant was aged 32 years, a multiplier of '16' would have to be applied.

Consequently, the claimant would be entitled to a sum of Rs.1,58,400/-(Rs.5,500 x 12 x 16 x 15%) towards 'loss of future income'.
8.
Having regard to the injuries suffered by the claimant, the claimant would be entitled to a sum of Rs.50,000/- towards 'pain and suffering' as against Rs.30,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.
9. The Tribunal has not awarded any compensation towards 'loss of amenities'.

Since it is held that the claimant had suffered disability at 15%, it would be appropriate to award a sum of Rs.50,000/-
towards loss of amenities.

10. Having regard to the length of the stay of the claimant in the hospital, the claimant would also be entitled to 'conveyance, food and nourishment and attendant charges' at Rs.20,000/- as against the sum of Rs.11,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.

11. The sums awarded as medical expenses by the Tribunal, being based on documentary evidence,
does not call for modification and hence confirmed.

12. Consequently the award of the Tribunal is modified and the claimant would be entitled to the following compensation:
 As As  awarded awarded  Sl. Compensation under by the by this  No. different Heads Tribunal Court  (Rs.) (Rs.)
 1. Pain and sufferings 30,000 50,000  2. Loss of future income 51,840 1,58,400  3.
Medical expenses 49,139 49,139 Prakash vs Jyothi Kumar on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20744665/
3  Conveyance, food, 11,000 20,000  6. nourishment, attendant  charges  7. Loss of amenities in life 0 50,000

13 . Thus, the claimant is held entitled to the total compensation of Rs.3,27,539/- as against Rs.1,41,979/-, along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till its realization.
14. The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the amount of compensation awarded within two months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
15. The claimant would not be entitled for the interest on the compensation for the delayed period of 408 days in filing the appeal.
16. The disbursement of the compensation amount shall be in terms of the award of the Tribunal.
17. The appeal is accordingly allowed in part.
